$comment: Max gzip KiB per example production bundle (ADR 0018, gyral-g1r.2). "budgets": all chunks concatenated; "initial": the entry chunk and its static imports, what a page downloads before any import() (gyral-g1r.18); "view": the view layer's client API built with the gyral-compiled condition (scripts/size/view-entry.js). Only ever lower these: pnpm size --check fails above a budget and suggests tightening when a bundle is 0.5 KiB under. Size pass (gyral-g1r.18): every budget is at most measured + 0.1 KiB; hello-world's initial budget is ADR 0018's 9.0 KiB target. The all-chunks budgets of examples that use each(), stores or forms (animated-letters, animation, autocomplete-search, devtools, http-search-github, nested-folders, no-js-first, shared-cart, typeahead-race) stay above their 0.2.0 baseline + 0.1: the lazily loaded hydration and invoker-fallback chunks (about 3.2 KiB gzip, compressed on their own) count there although client-only pages never fetch them; every initial chunk is 2.4-5.4 KiB below its 0.2.0 bundle. Template ids out of production client builds (gyral-g1r.22): every budget set to measured + 0.1 KiB, rounded to 0.1.
